acknowledgements.statement: This suite is a candidate-neutral postroot integrity-review companion input only.
This suite does not claim that any formal review, coverage, approval, index, or final result exists.

validation_rules: index never includes itself or final result
QUALIFIED requires exactly two distinct qualifying runs
integrity run must bind suite logical IDs in input_artifact_hashes
review_output_hash equals canonical bytes without hash field
review_run_id is content-derived with only review_run_id omitted
integrity run input_artifact_hashes must bind suite and suite approval
ELIGIBLE requires zero violations and all checks PASS
approval_record_id is content-derived with only approval_record_id omitted

effectivity.activation_condition: PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 explicitly approves this complete suite by logical ID and exact SHA-256 after review.
effectivity.determination_rule: Effectivity is established by external attributable exact-hash principal-approval evidence.
effectivity.self_hash_rule: This suite does not embed its own SHA-256.

structured_value.summary: Synthetic golden review output for contract validation.

supersession.revision_rule: Any content change requires new approval.
